column3: Get the Sigil of Strom for Zengu in Hammerfall.
column4: In ancient times, trolls fought against the Arathorian Empire and our most capable adversary, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, named Trollbane. He rode into battle wielding Trol'kalar--troll slayer, in their ancient tongue.$b$bBut now the sons of Trollbane are weakened, their stronghold brought to ruin.$b$bThe sword is protected by several sigils that were divided among the survivors of Stromgarde, and we must retrieve them.$b$bThe first was taken by the Syndicate, one of their men in Stromgarde should have it.

column3: Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity wants 20 Hearts of Zeal.
column4: Why do I need a rare type of guano, you might ask. Well, for this experiment I want to see what effect two diametrically opposed chemical substances can have on each other, especially when both are combined with an ever-toxic agent to ensure the most... ghastly results.$b$bIn the northeastern peaks of Tirisfal Glades lies the Scarlet Monastery. There the crazed disciples of the Scarlet Crusade congregate. Slay them and bring me their zealous hearts.$b$bOur concoction will be most wicked!

column3: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
column4: I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.\r\n\r\nIf you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.Escort Pal'juh out of Kolkar Crag.

column3: Kill $1oa Shadowhorn Stag and $2oa Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.
column4:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.

column3: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace.
column4: My brother in arms, Brother Anton, heard rumors of an undead infestation in distant Kalimdor, in a land known as Desolace.  Anton immediately booked passage to that place, to seek and destroy the undead menace!$B$BHe is looking for those with the bravery and resolve to aid him.  If your heart is true, then speak with Anton.  He is in Desolace, in the Alliance town of Nijel's Point.

column3: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Panthers.
column4: Now you're ready to turn it up a notch.  If you want to prove yourself worthy of socializing with the likes of these big game hunters, you'll need to prove that you can kill 10 panthers.$b$bThose big boys are tougher.  They're not as easy as the young ones you were killing earlier.

column3: Bring 4 Bracers of Earth Binding to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.
column4: The Magus will be busy studying those stone tokens you gathered, but I know he'll eventually want examples of their counterpart: bracers of binding.  These are set around the wrists of actual elementals, and bind them into the mage's service.$B$BHunt elementals in the ruins of Dalaran and gather their Bracers of Earth Binding, and the Magus will be pleased.

column3: Charge the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.$b$bDrive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore.
column4: Here, take the Rod of Helcular. You will need it.$b$bHelcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell.  The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains.$b$bThe Rod of Helcular must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore, the heavily guarded human town to the south.  Vengeance shall be ours!

column3: Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.
column4: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.\r\n\r\nCooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

column3: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
column4: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. $B$BGo, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
